verdict.rationale: LangGraph is installed as a library with `pip install -U langgraph` and runs entirely in your own environment. The docs support production use on your own infrastructure: they recommend a database-backed checkpointer (PostgresSaver), and the LangGraph CLI builds and runs the Agent Server locally with all run, thread and assistant endpoints plus checkpoint storage. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, documented production self-hosting of the Agent Server beyond local runs (a community user asked how to do this, with no answer in the evidence), and independent hands-on reports of self-hosted deployments.
